title: Quantum Simulation of Non-Markovian Open Quantum Systems via Low-Rank Kernel Compression and Coupling Dilution
summary: We present an error-controlled framework for the quantum simulation of non-Markovian open-system dynamics in Gaussian environments. For a system coupled linearly to a Gaussian environment with zero mean, the bath's influence on the reduced dynamics is completely determined by its two-time correlation kernel. This allows us to replace the microscopic environment with an equivalent bath that has the same kernel. On a finite simulation interval, a rank-$N$ approximation of the kernel yields an effective bath of $N$ bosonic modes with time-dependent couplings to the system. To encode these modes…
